programs.name: beehiiv Ad Network
programs.min_text: No minimum published. Needs any paid beehiiv plan and active sending.
programs.share: Not published (CPM or CPC set per campaign)
programs.payout: Paid on the 20th of the following month into the beehiiv Wallet; Stripe Express required; withdrawals free.

programs.name: Kit Newsletter Sponsorships
programs.min_text: No minimum stated. Only paid-plan users can express interest.
programs.share: Not published (pays per unique verified click)
programs.note: The older ConvertKit Sponsor Network page (convertkit.com/sponsor) listed 10,000+ engaged subscribers and a 20% fee. It looks superseded by the CPC sponsorships; treat it as legacy.

programs.name: Kit Paid Recommendations
programs.min_text: No minimum stated. Join the Creator Network and connect SparkLoop; approval usually within 24 hours.
programs.share: You earn $1 to $4+ per confirmed subscriber; Kit keeps 23.5% (20% service fee + 3.5% transaction fee)
programs.payout: Subscribers confirm after 1 to 28 days; payout schedule not verified

programs.name: SparkLoop Partner Network
programs.min_text: No defined minimum. SparkLoop suggests waiting until you have 500 to 1,000 subscribers.
programs.share: Brands pay $2 to $20 per new subscriber (SparkLoop's page); SparkLoop takes 20% + 3.5% of what you earn
programs.payout: Weekly (Thursdays) via Stripe Express in USD; $50 minimum net earnings; paid after SparkLoop is paid by the brand.

programs.name: Swapstack
programs.min_text: Not published on the pricing page.
programs.share: Free for publishers. 10% of ad spend on managed or invite-only campaigns. Paid publisher tiers listed at $30/mo and $200/mo (5% on booked campaigns).

programs.name: Paved Ad Network
programs.min_text: At least 50,000 subscribers, an active Paved publisher profile and a strong sending reputation.
programs.payout: Monthly, net-60, once you reach $1,000. Bank transfer, Wise or PayPal.

programs.name: Paved Marketplace
programs.min_text: Not published in the articles checked.
programs.share: Paved keeps 30% of bookings. Paved Booker is free apart from Stripe fees.
programs.payout: Not published (the net-60 / $1,000 terms are documented for the Ad Network only)

programs.name: Passionfroot
programs.min_text: No minimum published. Profiles are vetted for B2B fit; "Limited" profiles stay off the marketplace but can still take direct requests.
programs.share: Free to join. 15% fee on deals from its network; deals you source yourself carry a 5% fee charged to the sponsor.

programs.name: Letterhead
programs.share: Not published. Programmatic fill is quoted at $0.10 to $1.50 CPM on Letterhead's playbook page.

programs.name: EmailNewsletter.ad
programs.min_text: Apply at any size; built primarily for 25,000+ subscribers. Every newsletter is reviewed.
programs.share: You earn a share of advertiser billing; rates are shown in the dashboard and not published
programs.payout: Monthly. Stripe payouts once the balance reaches $100.
programs.requires: Review of your newsletter and sends

programs.name: Sponsy
programs.min_text: No minimum. It manages your own sponsor deals; it does not supply advertisers.
programs.share: No revenue share. Starter $0/mo with 5 free booked slots, then $5 per booked slot. Pro from $49/mo for up to 10 slots a month.
